text: 信达证券公告，中金公司拟通过换股方式吸收合并东兴证券、信达证券，本次交易已于2026年6月8日获公司股东会审议通过，并获中国证监会核准（证监许可〔2026〕2377号）。交易完成后，公司将不再具有独立主体资格并被注销，将于现金选择权申报截止日的次一交易日向上交所提交主动终止上市申请。上交所将在收到申请后5个交易日内决定是否受理，受理后15个交易日内决定是否同意终止上市；若获同意，公司将在相关决定公告之日起5个交易日内摘牌，股票不进入退市整理期交易。
text_en: Cinda Securities announced that CICC plans to absorb and merge Dongxing Securities and Cinda Securities through a share exchange. The transaction was approved by the company's shareholders' meeting on June 8, 2026, and approved by the CSRC (CSRC License No. [2026] 2377). Upon completion of the transaction, the company will lose independent legal person status and be deregistered, and will submit an application for voluntary delisting to the Shanghai Stock Exchange on the trading day following the deadline for cash option declaration. The exchange will decide within 5 trading days of receipt whether to accept the application, and within 15 trading days of acceptance whether to approve the delisting; if approved, the company will be delisted within 5 trading days of the announcement of the relevant decision, with shares not entering a delisting adjustment period.
